triage_adjudications.reasoning: The judge labeled eight models' rows reference_later_law (deepseek-v4-pro-0813, deepseek-v4.1-flash, gemini-3.7-flash, gemini-4-argon, grok-4.5, grok-4.6, grok-4.7 and grok-build-0.1) because they applied the pre-TCJA rules scheduled to return in 2026 (a smaller standard deduction, personal exemptions and a 15% second bracket). triage_adjudications.reference_basis: Wis. Stat. 71.05(10)(c)2. (for taxable years beginning after December 31, 2022, a net capital loss offsets ordinary income up to $3,000, or $1,500 for married persons filing separately); 2025 Wisconsin Schedule WD, line 28
triage_adjudications.reasoning: The judge flagged the reference on the hypothesis that Wisconsin limits the net capital loss deduction to $500, and labeled claude-opus-5.5's row reference_model_issue_fixed because it applied that limit. The $500 limit is Wis. Stat. 71.05(10)(c)1., which covers only taxable years beginning before January 1, 2023; for 2026, subd. 2. allows $3,000 on a joint return, the $3,000 the reference deducts, so Wisconsin adds nothing back and the reference's Wisconsin AGI of $114,421 stands. The rows are model errors.
